provenance.usage: One token_usage_record per model response; cumulative token_count events are not added again.
provenance.timing: Task lifecycle timestamps. Tool job intervals are detection bounds, can overlap, and must not be summed as elapsed authoring time.
provenance.privacy: Numeric aggregates only; no prompts, reasoning, tool commands, credentials or account identifiers are exported.

rates.basis: Hypothetical Go token-value cost using published GPT-6.1 Sol Standard API rates. Not an actual charge or official Go allowance tariff. Cache-write tokens are zero in the observed log. Reasoning output is included in output, not charged twice.
